Home.title: Build precise gauges in your browser.
Home.description: The editor workspace is ready for its first implementation stage. Create vector-based gauge layouts locally, then save them as JSON.

Help.title: Learn the editor
Help.description: The full in-app guide will grow alongside the available layers.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.description: Create a Range or open an example to begin.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: Use Layers to navigate and Properties to edit a layer.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Ranges define the coordinate and scale context for a gauge.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Projects are versioned JSON files validated before import.

status.placeholder: {action} is wired as a UI placeholder.
status.rangeRequired: Create a Range before adding a visual layer.

layers.title: Layers
layers.propertiesDescription: Adjust this visual element and its source Range.

picker.title: Choose a layer type
picker.description: Select the visual element you want to add to this gauge.
picker.tickScaleDescription: Draw radial tick marks using the selected Range.

layers.emptyDescription: Add a visual layer to start rendering your gauge.

ranges.title: Ranges
ranges.emptyDescription: Ranges define the position, radius, and value range used by visual layers.
ranges.deleteDisabled: Remove the {count, plural, one {dependent layer} other {# dependent layers}} before deleting this Range.

confirmation.deleteLayerDescription: This will permanently remove {name} from the project.
confirmation.deleteRangeDescription: This will permanently remove {name} and its value mapping from the project.

projectSettings.title: Project settings
projectSettings.description: Canvas dimensions are project data. Snapping is a local editor preference.

range.title: Range setup
range.description: Define the geometry, value mapping, and pivot context shared by visual layers.
range.scaleModeDescription: The editable curve controls will be introduced with the first scale layer.

canvas.emptyDescription: Create your first Range to define a dial, or select one of the starter examples.
